candidates: When adding a new `sb.mock(...)` entry to `code/.storybook/preview.tsx`, ensure the corresponding entry in `scripts/tasks/sandbox-parts.ts` uses identical mock options (e.g., `{ spy: true }`). These two files mirror each other for sandbox test environments; mismatched options mean sandboxes exercise different mock behavior than the dev preview.

Arrow callbacks passed to `Array.prototype.forEach` (and other iterable methods) must use block bodies — `(item) => { item.method(); }` — rather than concise arrow bodies — `(item) => item.method()` — to avoid returning a non-void value and triggering Biome's `lint/suspicious/useIterableCallbackReturn` lint error.
